scope: Luna 2.4 development and existing isolated staging only
eligibleUser: explicit server-side QA owner, verified Telegram identity
settlement: actual metered cost rounded upwards to microUSD; unknown usage/timeout retains entire hold
idempotency: existing reading reservation plus unique grant/reading budget claim
quota: only the configured staging owner receives up to eight Tarot reservations per UTC day; normal limits remain unchanged
storedHistory: GET never calls provider or reserves a budget; completed readings never regenerate
moonSeedsPaymentsSubscriptions: unchanged; no debit or payment RPC is called
rollback: disable the specific budget grant in staging; no deployment needed; retain audit and reading history

verification.staging: service-role success, anon/authenticated denial, owner boundary, cap, duplicate settlement and rollback checked

netlifyPolicy.developmentCommits: [skip netlify] [skip ci] until an explicitly approved release
